resources.string: Configure the welcome screen this TV will show to your guests.

Guests: press OK to open their apps. Host settings: press BACK 5 times, hold OK for 3 seconds, or press MENU.

To start automatically when the TV turns on, set OpenKiosk as the home screen. If your TV does not offer that option, run from a computer:
adb shell cmd package set-home-activity com.openkiosk.tv/.MainActivity
Invalid URL. It must start with https://
System settings are not available on this device
Use: adb shell cmd package set-home-activity com.openkiosk.tv/.MainActivity
The welcome screen will appear as soon as the internet connection is back.
This TV is not configured yet. Press BACK 5 times to open the settings.
New 6-digit PIN (leave empty to keep the current one)
Authenticator app: active. You can open settings with its code instead of the PIN.
Authenticator app: not set up. Recommended so you never get locked out.
Enter the host PIN or the current code from your authenticator app.
Enter the 12-character recovery code you saved when you created the PIN. It works only once.
Too many attempts. Try again in %1$d min.
Save these two things now. They are the only way back in if you forget the PIN.
Write it in your password manager. It is shown only this time and works once.
Scan the QR with Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, Authy or similar, then type the 6-digit code it shows.
Saved. You can set up the authenticator later from settings.
Code does not match. Check the time on your phone and try again.
QR code for the authenticator app
The PIN must be exactly 6 digits
Choose what to watch. The welcome screen comes back on its own after a few minutes.
No apps configured yet. The host can choose them in settings.
No TV apps found on this device
Back to welcome from the apps screen after (minutes, 0 = never)
Back to welcome when an app is paused or silent for (minutes, 0 = never)
Pause detection: needs a one-time permission. From a computer: adb shell cmd notification allow_listener com.openkiosk.tv/com.openkiosk.tv.MediaWatcherService
